reason: I only have Saturdays with my kid, and the zoo is free. A monthly membership I'd use maybe 3 or 4 times doesn't beat that, and it's a drive on top of the fee.
objection: It's a drive for us and gas adds up. Paying $59 a month for a place I can only use on weekends, when the zoo costs nothing, doesn't make sense.
would_change_my_mind: A weekend-only or per-visit pass around $25 to $30 a month, or a location close enough that it isn't a real trip.
